name: COPY MOVE
desc: Core COPY and MOVE semantics: JSON value construction, replacement across types, pair evaluation order, writable paths, auto-vivification, overlapping moves, deferred array deletion, queued half-index insertion, immediate appends, logical ownership, namespace permissions, validation, and abort behavior. Simple references, LENGTH, EXISTS, SLICE, CASTSTR, IF, and RAISE serve only as probes. Matching algorithms, named captures, macros, SPLIT metadata, resource stress, and implementation-specific partial failure trees are outside this collection. Where strict is absent, lazy expectations also apply under full local validation.

tests.name: COPY value construction and replacement
tests.desc: COPY accepts every JSON value and can replace an existing value of any type. Literal arrays use value-context escaping; reference results are already data.

tests.name: Lazy validation and abort behavior
tests.desc: Basic IF and RAISE actions provide reachability and execution-order probes only. This collection does not test matching semantics, captures, SPLIT metadata, rollback, or implementation-specific partial failure trees.
